quantum_computers.description: IQM Emerald is a quantum computer with a Crystal 54 QPU based on superconducting transmon qubits. The qubits are arranged in a square lattice and connected by tunable couplers. The system is calibrated to support arbitrary X and Y rotations as the native single-qubit gate and CZ as the native two-qubit gate.

quantum_computers.description: IQM Garnet is a 20-qubit quantum processing unit based on superconducting transmon qubits. The qubits are arranged in a square lattice and connected by tunable couplers. The system is calibrated to support arbitrary X and Y rotations as the native single-qubit gate and CZ as the native two-qubit gate.

quantum_computers.station_label: Mocked Olympus v2 station - Crystal 20 P08

quantum_computers.description: IQM Sirius boasts a star topology processor with 16 qubits all connected to one central computational resonator. In addition to single qubit rotations, all qubits can perform CZ gates with the subspace formed by the two lowest energy levels of the resonator. Furthermore, the novel MOVE operation is calibrated to exchange the occupations of the qubit-resonator states 0-1 and 1-0. It can therefore be used to shuttle excitations back and forth between any qubit and the resonator.
